_note: USD per million tokens, Global Standard, short-context rates, from the Azure Retail Prices API (eastus) on 2026-11-09. A model is priced by the longest key that appears in its deployment name (lower-cased). cache_read / cache_write are multipliers on the input rate. Long-context requests cost more (6.1-sol 4.0/15.0, astra 20.0/75.0): not modelled, our packets are well under that tier. The API listed no output meter for 6.1-terra: its 5.0 is an UNVERIFIED assumption. Global Flex tiers are about half price (6.1-sol 1.0/5.0) if a Flex deployment is ever used. Unknown models fall back to 'default' (the dearest rate) so a budget cap trips early. DeepSeek and Kimi rows are the Microsoft-billed Global meters from the same API (2026-11-11). A call served on the Flex tier is costed at half (bedrock_llm.price_usd).
